items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: Him and Barberman, Louie Barberman. Uh-huh. And all the two real old ones, Louie and Josiah. They are drummers.

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)
ctx.x: You say he took a few drum lessons from Saeed when he was there.
Yeah, when I was little. Well, he's about the best one out there now. Uh-huh. Him and Barberman, Louie Barberman. Uh-huh. And all the two real old ones, Louie and Josiah. They are drummers.

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)
ctx.x: Let him know what you're interested mostly in. One of them, yeah.
